title: otto kgcov_matrix.json
description: The otto_kgcov compatibility matrix: {contract} x {compiler}, per venue (design 2026-09-18). A sibling of support-matrix.schema.json with the same three rules -- only a run writes a verdict, every verdict carries its provenance, a lost verdict stops the release -- and the same `cells[surface][profile].status` nesting, which is what lets scripts/check_matrix_downgrades.py gate both. HAND-WRITTEN, like that file, in its house style.

format.title: Format
format.description: Document version. Required with no default: an unversioned file fails loud rather than validating as an empty modern one.

surfaces.title: Surfaces
surfaces.description: The matrix rows, in render order. tests/unit/test_kgcov_matrix.py asserts this set equals the contracts the tree declares, both ways.

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.description: The matrix columns, in render order: the Makefile's default KGCOV_TOOLCHAINS, then the cross build.

cells.title: Cells
cells.description: The grid, keyed surface id -> profile id -> cell. An object, not a list: keys cannot collide, so no (surface, profile) pair can carry two verdicts.

contract.title: Contract
contract.description: The test's nodeid without its [compiler] parametrization.

control.title: Control
control.description: Whether this row is the bed columns' positive control: the library refusing a demo from another compiler. A bed cell may be measured-ok only when the control passed in the same run.

id.title: Id
id.description: The name the lane selects by (gcc-12, clang, x86_64-cross); the measured version lives on the cell.

Cell.title: Cell
Cell.description: One (contract, compiler) verdict with the evidence that earned it. Three states: measured-ok and measured-broken carry the run's provenance; untested carries status alone.

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: What pytest reported. A skip never reaches the artifact: the collate step discards it with a reason.

compiler_version.title: Compiler Version
compiler_version.description: The compiler's -dumpfullversion (clang: -dumpversion) on the machine that measured.

kernel_release.title: Kernel Release
kernel_release.description: The release the modules were built for: the bed's running kernel, or the cross tree's include/config/kernel.release.

control.title: Control
control.description: For a bed cell, the control contract's nodeid whose passing record backs this verdict; null for the build column, which has no control and whose cells prove what a build can prove.

failure_summary.title: Failure Summary
failure_summary.description: How a measured-broken cell broke: the failing phase's last E line, or the control's own outcome when the control did not pass.

NodeId.title: NodeId
NodeId.description: A pytest nodeid rooted at tests/, WITHOUT parametrization: the matrix's column is the parametrization.

Venue.title: Venue
Venue.description: bed: the module was loaded on the lab's unix hosts; build: it was only built (the x86_64 cross build).
